name: Lisa Crowe
methodsExpertise: Researching topics of a highly sensitive and distressing nature
bio: Lisa Crowe is a skilled qualitative researcher with extensive experience in ethnography, in-depth interviews, cognitive interviewing, and participatory action research. Her work includes recruiting, training, and collaborating with peer researchers, as well as leading research on sensitive and emotionally challenging topics. As an RSS Core Methodologist, she provides methodological support to researchers developing funding applications, including grant reviews, application feedback, and mock interview preparation.
